{{The Crash Course/en}}{{Se inspekte/en}}
[[CLL|Standard Lojban]] has 7 words for "and" depending on the syntactical role of "and" in sentence. Namely,
#'''je''' is "and" conjunction for linking parts of compound verbs. (e.g. "quickly <u>and</u> gently run")
#'''.e''' is "and" for linking nouns/pronouns/personal names (My friend <u>and</u> I came home)
#'''zi'e''' is "and" for linking two relative clauses belonging to one noun/pronoun (The king who ruled for 30 years <u>and</u> who died later...)
#'''gi'e''' is "and" for linking two verb phrases belonging to one sentence with one head (I like apples <u>and</u> eat them).
#'''ge ... gi''' is "and" for forethought connectives (<u>Both</u> you <u>and</u> I like it).
#'''gu'e ... gi''' is "and" for forethought connectives in compound verbs (I run <u>both</u> quickly <u>and</u> gently).
#'''.ije''' is "and" for linking two verb phrases belonging to one sentence (I like apples <u>and</u> you like them too).
Now since a new formal grammar is implemented in the form of a new grammatical [[The Crash Course: ilmentufa|parser]] for items 1 till 3 only one word '''je''' is enough, the parser will understand where "and" belongs to automatically. Items 4 till 6 can be formed with '''je''' with additional words. Item 7 remains as it is as it's already reuses '''je''' as expected.

Why so? Because the initial Loglan/Lojban grammar was based on BNF/YACC syntactic parsers.

This grammar was a major breakthrough at the time when it was applied to a human language. In fact, when it appeared Loglan was rewritten having such formal grammar as a thing prescriptive to forming a language.


However, these days Lojban has changed to [[PEG]] grammar, which allows for means for using only one word for "and" in all cases above.

Every time the parser is improved Lojban becomes more and more human-friendly.

Compared to the original Loglan as of 1980 Lojban is now a completely reworked language (read e.g. [[Stub: Lojbab about the history of Lojban|Lojbab about the history of Lojban]] for more details. Some courses already [[The Crash Course method|teach]] these alternative solutions.

This doesn't mean Lojban community is going to break formal grammar making Lojban an easily learnable language in hope that future parsers will handle it. Lojban simply has a different goal.
